_metadata.purpose: LEDGER Q58 verification: every record the classification left weak, pending, insufficient or unfound was checked against primary sources (FDA notices, FDA tainted-products database, eCFR 2026-09-30, US Code, openFDA, archived FDA release). No data or routing changed.
_metadata.rules_applied: Sean 2026-10-02: A active recall -> Recalled product; B ended recall with known lot -> Recalled lot; C product-name-only match on an ended recall -> no permanent block; D an ingredient that triggers its own rule blocks for that reason; WADA-only never blocks; shared hazard is not shared identity.
_metadata.label_note: proposed_label is the plain reader label; mapping to legal_status_enum and title prefix happens in the routing step after Sean's review.
